# `gameplay/rules/RuleGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/rules/RuleGraph.js`

RuleGraph — The master rule resolver for LIFE. Everything in the world passes through RuleGraph to decide what is legal. Rules have priorities (1=highest), conditions, effects, and sources. When rules conflict, the highest priority wins. Ties break by specificity. Priority levels: 1 = Engine safety (cannot crash the game) 2 = Physics / material (fire burns wood) 3 = Survival / body (hunger kills) 4 = World rules (gravity, time) 5 = Law / faction (city forbids theft) 6 = Item rules (sword needs two hands) 7 = Contract rules (guardian vow restricts solo fighting) 8 = Domain rules (domain overrides local reality) 9 = Temporary status / visual (buff, aura, particle effect)

## Classes

### `class RuleGraph`

RuleGraph — singleton-style rule management and resolution.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |
| `addRule` | `addRule(rule)` | Register a rule. |
| `removeRule` | `removeRule(ruleId)` | Remove a rule by ID. |
| `removeRulesBySource` | `removeRulesBySource(source)` | Remove all rules from a specific source. |
| `getRule` | `getRule(ruleId)` | Get a rule by ID. |
| `purgeExpired` | `purgeExpired(now)` | Remove expired rules. Call periodically. |
| `isAllowed` | `isAllowed(action, context)` | Query: Is this action allowed given the current context? Gathers all matching rules, sorts by priority (ascending = higher priority first), then by specificity (descending), and resolves conflicts. |
| `resolve` | `resolve(action, context)` | Query: What result does an action produce after all modify/replace rules? Runs the action through all matching MODIFY and REPLACE rules in priority order. |
| `explain` | `explain(action, context)` | Explain why a specific action would be allowed or denied. Returns a human-readable explanation chain. |
| `getActiveRules` | `getActiveRules(filter)` | Get all active rules matching a filter. |
| `getLastTrace` | `getLastTrace()` | Get the trace log from the most recent isAllowed() or resolve() call. |
| `size` | `get size()` | Get total number of registered rules. |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get stats for debugging. |
| `clear` | `clear()` | Remove all rules. Use for testing or full reset. |
| `serialize` | `serialize()` | Serialize all rules to a plain array (for save/debug). Note: condition and apply functions are NOT serializable — only metadata is saved. |

## Functions

### `createRule(config)`

Creates a new rule object.

**Parameters:**

- `config` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `config.name` *(string)* — Human-readable rule name
- `config.category` *(string)* — One of RuleCategory values
- `config.source` *(string)* — Who/what created this rule (entity id, system name, etc.)
- `config.effect` *(string)* — One of RuleEffect values
- `config.condition` *(function)* — (action, context) => boolean — when does this rule apply?
- `config.apply` *(function|*)* — (action, context) => result — what happens when rule fires
- `[config.tags]` *(string[])* — Content tags for filtering
- `[config.specificity]` *(number)* — Higher = more specific (breaks ties within same priority)
- `[config.expiry]` *(number)* — Timestamp when rule expires, null for permanent
- `[config.description]` *(string)* — Human-readable explanation

**Returns:** Frozen rule object
